name: Knectiv
old_description: Hardware manufacturing, managed from engineering to production.
about:
Knectiv operates from Austin, Texas. The company was founded by Nicholas J. Frank, who serves as CEO, and Michael Lally, co‑founder. Together they built a firm that connects product engineering with global manufacturing execution, aiming to simplify hardware commercialization for clients.

The company provides end‑to‑end hardware manufacturing management, spanning product engineering, design for manufacturability, PCB fabrication and assembly, plastic injection molding, component sourcing, and turnkey production. Knectiv coordinates manufacturing globally, offering U.S.‑side accountability with production execution in China when needed, and supports programs from prototype through scale‑up.

Knectiv serves industrial, medical, consumer, automotive, audio, and connected‑hardware markets. Its customers include Swiss medical‑device maker GETS, audio‑technology firm Merging Technologies, air‑quality instrumentation company Zefon International, and automotive supplier CEBI Micromotors. The portfolio features devices such as the HemataStat microhematocrit centrifuge, MOHE LFIA reader, CO2EFFICIENT endoscopic insufflator, and Bluetooth‑enabled Elmore pedal.

Knectiv differentiates itself through a unified approach that consolidates engineering, supply chain, quality, and logistics under a single point of contact. The firm states that this model delivers simplified management, consistent quality, and greater efficiency, allowing clients to focus on innovation while Knectiv handles manufacturing complexity.
